items.label: Capture the PLAN room orchestration context.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, risks, and unknowns are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > agent-and-skill-design, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward with planning-partner and documentation-authority-steward responsibilities, phase target phase-agent-and-skill-design-plan-room-orchestration-rules, checklist target checklist-agent-and-skill-design-plan-room-orchestration-rules, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules-2026-09-02.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard for PLAN room orchestration.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control test fails before the PLAN Room Orchestration Rules document, records, and entrypoint references exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because doc-flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules was not linked from the project-control node and Project Control entrypoints did not reference docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md.

items.label: Define how PLAN assesses N WORK rooms.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules define N WORK rooms, laneDependencyGraph, dispatch sets, parallelLimit, held-back lanes, and safe fallback to one room when ownership or dependencies are unclear.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md defines N WORK room assessment and requires the PLAN room to record why the selected parallelLimit is safe before opening new WORK rooms.

items.label: Define the Room Run Registry.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules define minimum roomRunId, Codex task/chat reference, lane, owner, phase/checklist/evidence, worktree/branch, status, handoff, and next PLAN action fields.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md records the Room Run Registry and states that until a dedicated schema exists it may live in bounded PLAN handoff notes or Work/Checklist records.

items.label: Define handoff inbox and completion queue processing.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules define handoffInbox, completionQueue, pull review for rooms that do not push handoffs, and acceptanceGate sequencing before evidence registration or dependent lane dispatch.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md records pull review, handoffInbox, completionQueue, and acceptanceGate rules, including one-at-a-time PLAN processing when multiple WORK rooms finish together.

items.label: Route future PLAN rooms to the orchestration rules.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control AGENTS.md, global Codex guidance, agent operating model, delivery operating model, and first delivery round plan reference the PLAN Room Orchestration Rules.

items.label: Record Project Control records for PLAN room orchestration.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Document, Work context update, Phase, Checklist, Evidence, and Project Control Node link without product truth promotion.
items.verificationNote: Registered doc-flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules, phase-agent-and-skill-design-plan-room-orchestration-rules, checklist-agent-and-skill-design-plan-room-orchestration-rules, evidence-flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules-2026-09-02, and the project-control node document link; product repositories and map truth were intentionally not changed.

items.label: Verify the focused guard and Project Control gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused PLAN Room Orchestration guard, generation, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass before handoff.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check pass after Project Control records are registered.
